draft.shortGloss: to climb; to board; to rise
draft.emotion: active and determined, focused on reaching a higher point
notes: Intransitive verb (does not take ने in the perfective). Its opposite is उतरना (to climb down, get off).
Takes पर or में for the surface, stairs, or vehicle being climbed or boarded (सीढ़ियों पर चढ़ना, बस में/पर चढ़ना).

senses.definition: To move or go upwards, such as up stairs, a hill, or a tree.

examples.text: वह पहाड़ पर चढ़ रहा है।
examples.emotion: strenuous and focused, feeling the effort of the ascent

senses.definition: To get on a vehicle such as a bus, train, or boat.
Of fever, prices, or water level: to rise, increase, or come on.

examples.text: उसे तेज़ बुख़ार चढ़ गया है।
examples.translation: He has come down with a high fever.

faults.quote: it is always paired with the postposition 'पर' (on).
